product_overview: AI Image Prompts is a free, public web platform offering a vast library of curated AI image generation prompts with preview images. It is designed for AI artists, designers, content creators, and enthusiasts to browse, copy, save, and submit high-quality prompts seamlessly without signup friction. The site also includes educational content, community features, and a robust administrative backend for content and analytics management.
core_goals: Provide frictionless access to a comprehensive library of AI image generation prompts with preview images to inspire and aid AI creators.
Enable efficient discovery through powerful search, filters, categories, and tags to find relevant prompts quickly.
Support authenticated users with personalized features like saving favorite prompts and submitting new prompts to the community.
Offer educational blog content and resources about AI art and prompt engineering to foster user engagement and knowledge.
Maintain strong administrative capabilities for content moderation, analytics, category/tag management, and system settings.
Ensure high performance, accessibility, and responsive design with modern technologies and SEO best practices.
key_features: Landing Page with hero section, featured prompts, testimonials, and call-to-action to explore the prompt library.
Explore Page with advanced search, multiple filters, category/tag navigation, and a grid display of prompts with preview images.
Prompt Detail Page showing full prompt text, preview images, one-click copy functionality, prompt ratings, related prompts, and discovery tracking analytics.
Authentication via Clerk supporting anonymous browsing, user sign-up, login, and admin access with protected routes.
Saved Prompts feature allowing authenticated users to bookmark and manage favorite prompts with search capabilities.
Prompt Submission form enabling community members to submit new prompts for admin review and approval.
Comprehensive Blog System with rich text editing, SEO metadata, scheduling, and content management.
Admin Dashboard for managing prompts, categories, tags, blog posts, bulk uploads, email subscriptions, analytics integrations, and application settings including maintenance mode.
Category and Tag Management with metadata including icons, colors, descriptions, and tag alias normalization for consistent discovery.
Short Link Tracking and analytics system supporting URL shortening, UTM parameters, and click monitoring.
Discovery Events Tracking for analytics on how prompts are found and engaged with by users.
Dark/Light Theme support with system preference detection.
Cookie Consent banner for GDPR compliance.
Contact form for user inquiries with location tracking and admin message management.
Donation page integration with Buy Me a Coffee to support the project.
FAQ and Guidelines pages for user assistance and community standards guidance.
Legal pages covering terms of service, privacy policy, cookie policy, and refund policy.
user_flow_summary: A visitor lands on the Landing Page to learn about the platform and accesses featured prompts or navigates to explore the prompt library.
Users browse prompts on the Explore Page, use search and filtering options, and click prompts to view detailed pages with full prompt info and copy prompts instantly.
Authenticated users can save favorite prompts to their personal collection and manage these via the Saved Prompts page.
Community users submit new prompt ideas through the Submit Prompt form, which are then reviewed by admin users in the admin interface before publishing.
Admin users log into a protected Admin Dashboard to manage all aspects of content including prompts, categories, tags, blog posts, and monitor analytics and system settings.
Users access educational content via the Blog, About, FAQ, and Guidelines pages for information and support.
Visitors can contact support through the Contact form; donations can be made on the Donate page to help fund the platform.
validation_criteria: Prompts must display preview images, titles, categories, and tags correctly and enable one-click copying to clipboard with no signup required for public users.
Search and filter functionality on the Explore Page must return accurate and relevant prompt results efficiently for various style, subject, mood, and category queries.
Authentication system must securely support anonymous browsing, user login/signup via Clerk, and restrict admin routes to authorized users.
Saved prompts must be correctly persisted per user and allow management such as searching and removing favorites.
Prompt submissions must include validation of input data and send new prompts for review; admin approval is required before making prompts public.
Blog post creation and editing must support rich text editing, SEO metadata, scheduling, and publishing workflows without errors.
Admin dashboard features must allow creation, editing, and deletion of prompts, categories, tags, and blog posts with immediate data consistency and analytics updates.
Analytics tracking for prompt discovery and link clicks must collect, store, and display data correctly in admin interfaces including Google Analytics integration.
Theme switching between dark and light modes must honor user system preferences and enable manual toggling.
Cookie consent banner must display based on GDPR rules and store user preferences appropriately.
Navigation throughout the website must be smooth and responsive across devices and accessible according to WCAG guidelines.
Legal pages must be accessible and display up-to-date policies relevant to user privacy and platform terms.
